decisions.title: Keep live upload blocked until server target is confirmed
decisions.reason: The package is ready, but uploading without domain, host, path, and rollback details can overwrite or hide the wrong site.

decisions.title: Start mobile as PWA-first until native requirements are clearer
decisions.reason: The current static shell already has responsive, offline, low-motion, and server packaging support without adding mobile build complexity.

decisions.title: Use language contracts before adding services
decisions.reason: The branch can stay many-language ready without dependency bloat, process managers, or heavy runtime surfaces.
